text:
Nadia Gomez: Quick sync: proposal to implement TTL-based decay + hysteresis window on demote->evict. Goal: reduce oscillation for hot prefixes.

Ethan Liu: Love it. Two concerns: perf on hot path and fairness across tenants.

Priya Kapoor: Perf mitigation: precompute decay buckets per TTL class and use integer math. Also add fast path when ttl==null (no decay).

Samir Patel: Fairness: tenant_weight helps but add an upper cap per tenant and a soft floor. Otherwise heavy tenants starve small ones.

Nadia Gomez: Hysteresis idea: a prefix must be demoted for N seconds before eligible for eviction; N is a function of slab pressure and tenant priority. Keeps short-lived spikes from full eviction.

Ethan Liu: Implementation sketch: descriptor carries tenant_id, ttl_seconds (optional), demote_ts; eviction worker computes score = hotness * bucket_decay * tenant_weight. If current_time - demote_ts < hysteresis(prefix) => force demote score boost to delay eviction.

Priya Kapoor: API: add optional prefix_ttl_seconds and optional tenant_cap in tenant admin. Default prefix_ttl_seconds=null (legacy). Document semantics carefully for 0 and negative values.

Samir Patel: Rollout: feature-flagged, canary 1% with alerts on eviction_churn, read tail latency and demote_duration. If churn increases > 20% rollback.

ops-bot: Canary deployed: evict-ttl-hysteresis v1 -> canary 1% -> started 2026-05-10T09:00Z

Nadia Gomez: Tests: unit math, perf microbench (no added syscall per token), integration replay with production hotkey traces, chaos test simulating tenant surge.

Ethan Liu: Also add telemetry: per-tenant demote_duration histogram, eviction_after_demote_count, tenant_cap_hits. That will help tune hysteresis function.

Priya Kapoor: Note: must ensure descriptor epoch update path is idempotent and cheap; use existing manifest CAS to avoid extra writes.

Samir Patel: I'll draft runbook for canary and emergency rollback including safe demote thresholds and how to flip to demote-only mode.

Nadia Gomez: Action items: Nadia implement descriptor TTL + demote_ts, Ethan perf table, Priya API docs & examples, Samir runbook. I'll open PRs and link here.

ops-bot: Canary health snapshot (3h): eviction_churn +1.8%, demote_durations stable, no alerts.
